name: graphe
description: The Graphe tab of /panel, also opened by /graphe [recherche]: the pane draws the writings graph in ASCII: a force-directed layout of the strongest nodes, or of one node and its neighbours. Live centre: the pane re-centres on the node closest to the conversation (words of your last prompts, then the corpus passages that echo them, by words and by meaning, then Haiku to break a tie) until you pin one with /graphe <recherche>; below the graph, the passages the centre's mentions fall in. The passages come from a local corpus server, one child process while the pane is open

journal.title: Build journal
journal.description: JSON-lines file whose last line describes the last build

centrage.title: Live centre
centrage.description: haiku: the words of your last prompts and the corpus passages that echo them, with Haiku to break a tie or a miss; lexical: the same without Haiku; off: the pane never follows the conversation, and no corpus server runs, so no passages show even under a centre you pinned

node.title: Node
node.description: The Node.js (24 or later) that runs the corpus server

serveur.title: Corpus server
serveur.description: The corpus server script, run with --index <coffre>/index-corpus.json; empty: no passages, the words and Haiku alone

lang.title: Language
lang.description: fr: the pane and the replies in French; en: in English. The graph data (ids, relations, quotes) is shown as written
